en: This is a black-and-white image depicting a grand neoclassical building with prominent columns and a clock, alongside a more modern structure. There are several people, classic automobiles, and carts in the foreground, indicating a busy square. The architecture and vehicles suggest a historical period. The bottom of the postcard contains Swedish text: 'Karlskrona. Rådhuset och Konserthuset.' and 'FÖRLAG NORDISK KONST STOCKHOLM.'
